fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Patio Area; Detached Structure; Storage Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Structures; Single Access Point; Limited Rear Access; Dense Vegetation
fr.recommendations:
• Post a visible address marker at the street entrance that can be read from both directions of travel.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts or markers so it is identifiable at night or in low-visibility conditions.
• Keep the single driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach both structures without obstruction.
• Identify and mark any secondary path to the rear of the property so responders are not limited to a single route.
• Keep a rear access point unlocked or clearly marked so responders can reach the back of the property without having to breach a barrier.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway to maintain clearance wide enough for emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation between the main residence and detached structure to allow responders to move between the two buildings.
• Keep the walkway between structures clear of stored items, equipment, or debris at all times.
• Mark the location of the detached structure on any posted site map or address placard so arriving responders know a second building is present on the property.
• Keep the storage area clear of materials stacked against exterior walls to allow responders to move around the perimeter of that structure.
• Keep the vehicle parking area free of inoperable or abandoned vehicles that would reduce the available staging area for emergency equipment.
